title: netlink-nl80211: Dissect NL80211_ATTR_CIPHER_SUITES
description:
Dissect NL80211_ATTR_CIPHER_SUITES in netlink-nl80211. Expose the
value string from the IEEE 802.11 dissector to do so.

Note that unlike the IEEE 802.11 definition, where the Suite selector
is a 4-byte array consisting of a 3-byte OUI followed by a one byte
selector, nl80211 treats it as an unsigned 32-bit number in the native
Endian encoding. Thus the OUI needs to be part of a bitmask.

To support this, relax the restriction on having bitmask values with
BASE_OUI; allow it if the bitmask has exactly 24 bits set, so that the OUI
is entirely included.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: netlink-nl80211.c hf_nl80211_supported_cipher_suite_oui filter= nl80211.supported_cipher_suite.oui mask 0xffffff00 with len is 8 but type FT_UINT24  indicates max of 6 and extra digits are non-zero (ff)
